items.title: Enriching Product Catalogs For Agentic Commerce Discovery with MongoDB
items.summary: Retail discovery is moving from clicks and filters to a conversation an AI agent conducts on a customer’s behalf. A customer may ask an AI answer engine like ChatGPT or Gemini for a carry-on bag that fits a 16-inch laptop and has strong sustainability credentials. They may instruct an AI agent to watch for price drops in high-end bean-to-cup coffee machines. The products selected by AI agents in those scenarios will not be based on the most persuasive product description on a retailer’s website
